# Daily Routine

**What to work on each day.** Claude reads this to guide user through listed Blocks. DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE - each block manages its progress individually. Keep a daily log and progress tracker for each block inside their directory called "progress.md".

## The shape of a day

**Resets daily.** Work down the list in order; the next session starts at the beginning.

| Block | What
|---|---|---|

| **2** | **Security+ — 3 hours** — follow /security-plus/README.md
| **3** | **Homelab — 3 hours** — Tracked privately in the homelab repo
